# Governed workbench design lab

**BACKENDLESS PROTOTYPE. Synthetic data.** Nothing is saved, approved, delivered,
generated by a model, or authenticated. A simulated role is a presentation preview.
All fixtures are public within this demo, including illustrative redactions.

## Explore

From agentic-kit, with the app-kit prototype-lab binary on PATH:

```sh
prototype-lab check -dir prototypes/governed-workbench
portless run --name agentic-workbench prototype-lab serve -dir prototypes/governed-workbench
```

Build the standalone tool from app-kit with:

```sh
go build -o /your/bin/prototype-lab ./cmd/prototype-lab
```

Tooling contribution: app-kit `9e6b393e`, delivered on main through `5374f044`.
No agentic-kit runtime dependency is added. The server needs
Portless's injected `PORT`, serves declared local assets, and denies network calls
through CSP. Use trusted local authored code. This is not a sandbox.

Preview: http://agentic-workbench.localhost:1355

The top strip controls the experiment. Switch scenario, presentation, simulated
role and theme. Scenario changes clear simulated decisions. Presentation changes
retain the selected subject and draft state. Reload resets everything.

| Scenario | Try | Design question |
|---|---|---|
| `prose-conflict` | Select a claim, compare sources, correct, rebuild, review | Is the cause of a publication block clear? |
| `prose-variants` | Switch Executive / Technical audiences | Can required meaning survive audience changes? |
| `agent-suggestion` | Bind purpose/destination/expiry, approve, change destination | Is exact consent understandable? |
| `review-queue` | Select ready/blocked items; switch Reader | Can a short review stay safe and simple? |
| `evidence-gap` | Inspect missing, stale and denied sources | Does each absence suggest the right next action? |
| `investigation-ladder` | Spend a bounded synthetic allowance or stop | Is escalation understandable without fake prices? |
| `privacy-review` | Request reveal/export | Can authority boundaries be explained without disclosure? |
| `delivery-unknown` | Query unknown/delivered/absent; require a fresh decision | Can recovery avoid a duplicate send? |
| `clarification` | Answer, mark unknown, defer | Can the human reject a disputed premise? |
| `stale-approval` | Rebuild affected content and review its new revision | Are reuse and stale consent distinguishable? |
| `model-catalog` | Trace available through selected sets | Is availability distinct from task eligibility? |
| `learning-flywheel` | Review, reproduce, shadow, receiver acceptance | Can a lesson advance without silently changing policy? |

Four presentations explore one subject: **inline**, **panel**, **split**, **full**.
Six task views share selection and the Evidence / Criteria / History inspector.
Examples: `?scenario=prose-conflict&mode=full&view=prose`,
`?scenario=agent-suggestion&mode=panel&view=review`, and
`?scenario=review-queue&mode=inline&view=review`.

## Scope and review

Questions, owner and review conditions are in `prototype.json`. Review by
2026-11-21 or the next release. Keyboard, responsive and browser observations are
recorded in the [experience design](../../docs/designs/agentic-engineering/workbench-experience.md).
They do not prove production accessibility, usability, authorization or adoption.
Runtime acceptance remains in HW/PH and the existing work order.

The original layout interprets the complete Tailwind Plus HTML / Tailwind 4 light
reference **Application UI.Application Shells.Multi-Column Layouts.Constrained
three column**, from `application-ui-v4.zip`, SHA-256
`b26cbf6e9529c2219452de32b1a9c49ca12d7bc63bca5e48cd286088521ba0e8`.
It retains queue/task/inspector hierarchy, quiet borders, editorial reading width,
consistent gutters and responsive stacking. It deliberately uses original CSS,
no licensed assets, and a wider task canvas for document review. No shared
workbench runtime component or app-kit quality certification is implied.

Promote individual proven interactions through their owning app or app-kit layer.
Do not import this bundle into production. Delete a retired bundle after recording
its decision. Git retains the experiment without an archive directory.
